results.title: Failed notifications are logged with the error and a retry time
results.evidence: portal email #1 status=failed error='simulated delivery failure (EMAIL_BACKEND=fai...' retry scheduled at 2026-10-02 04:37:51.814072; CRM email #1 status=failed

results.title: Admins can see failed emails and retry them
results.evidence: admin retry while SMTP is down -> still 'failed' (attempt counted); failures visible to portal admin (1) and CRM owner (1)

results.title: Failed emails are delivered when retried after recovery
results.evidence: after SMTP recovered: portal email #1 -> sent; CRM retry-failed sent 1/1

results.title: Login / logout (logout revokes tokens immediately)
results.evidence: portal: token works -> logout -> same access token 401, refresh 401; CRM: same (access token rejected immediately after logout)

results.title: Password reset
results.evidence: portal + CRM: reset email queued -> new password works, old password fails, existing sessions revoked, reset link single-use

results.title: Session expiry
results.evidence: expired access tokens -> 401 and expired sessions can't be refreshed (portal + CRM); access tokens last 60 min, sessions 7 days

results.title: Multiple-device sessions
results.evidence: portal: 3 devices listed, revoking one signs only that device out, logout-all ends the rest; CRM: back-to-back logins both succeed (3 sessions), per-device revoke works

results.title: Account lockout / rate limiting
results.evidence: 5 wrong passwords -> account locked (423) even for the right password, on both apps; 25 rapid attempts from one IP -> 429 after 20 (portal) / 20 (CRM) with Retry-After

results.title: Unauthorized dashboard access
results.evidence: 7 API probes rejected (401 without login, 403 wrong role); all 4 portal dashboards and the CRM layout redirect unauthorised users

results.title: Data leakage
results.evidence: another company's recruiter can't read the conversation or applicants (404); draft jobs hidden from the public; chatbot visitors no longer share one conversation; resumes not served from public /static; live-notification socket refuses connections without a valid token; CRM HR users can't open others' leads/tasks by ID or see billing

results.title: API authorization
results.evidence: 8 authorization probes behave correctly; manual ATS score ignored (stays 10)

results.title: Role permissions
results.evidence: 31 role/endpoint combinations match the permission matrix (owner / BDM / HR)

results.title: Candidate document security
results.evidence: fake PDF rejected (400), >5 MB rejected (413); recruiter gets a signed link that works; unsigned, tampered and expired links -> 403; another candidate can't attach my resume; javascript: links refused; CRM: content-checked uploads, private storage, signed links only

results.title: Royalty / incentive manipulation
results.evidence: there is no API to create or edit an incentive amount (405); HR can't change rates or approve their own payout (403); HR sees only their own incentives; amount = invoice 140,000 x 5.0% = 7,000, computed by the server for exactly the credited recruiter and BDM; fee and credited recruiter can't be set by the client; invoice amount override: BDM 403, owner needs a reason (audited); incentives voided when the invoice is cancelled (2) and when the candidate leaves within guarantee (2)

results.title: Duplicate candidates
results.evidence: same email (different case) and same phone (different format) -> 409 naming the existing record; owner can merge duplicates: applications move over, missing fields filled, duplicate removed; portal: 8 simultaneous apply clicks -> exactly 1 application

results.title: ATS workflow
results.evidence: portal: forward moves allowed; moving back, hiring without an offer and changing a hired application are blocked (409); full history recorded; only the candidate can withdraw; CRM: unknown stages, skipping to hired and moving back blocked; duplicate pipeline entry 409; candidate status follows the stage

results.title: MOU / billing linkage
results.evidence: placement blocked with no MOU or a draft MOU; only the owner activates or changes active terms; fee = 12.5% x CTC 12,00,000 = 1,50,000 frozen at offer (unchanged after the MOU went to 20%); invoice only after joining, once per placement, 1,50,000 + 18% GST = 1,77,000, due in the MOU's 30 days

results.title: Audit logs
results.evidence: CRM records who changed what with before/after values (e.g. lead temperature cold->hot), the invoice override reason, and 7 security events; portal admin log shows 5 failed logins, 1 lockouts, 3 ATS status changes and 5 job changes

results.title: Candidate updates
results.evidence: portal: candidate emailed on every status change; CRM: candidate emailed when shortlisted, the recruiter who added them gets an in-app alert

results.title: Interview notifications
results.evidence: scheduling emails the candidate and alerts interviewers in-app; rescheduling sends an update; the scheduler sends a reminder inside 24 h; past times rejected

results.title: Joining notifications
results.evidence: candidate gets a congratulations email on joining and a reminder the day before; owner/BDM/recruiter get in-app joining alerts

results.title: Employer / client notifications
results.evidence: client's primary contact emailed on joining (3) and when invoices are raised (4)

results.title: HR / BDM alerts
results.evidence: lead and task assignments alert the assignee (in-app + email); follow-ups remind 15 min ahead; overdue invoices alert owners and BDMs

results.title: Slow queries
results.evidence: all key endpoints p95 < 500 ms on seeded data; slowest: CRM GET /jobs/{id} (2,000 applicants) p95 165 ms; requests over 1 s are logged as warnings

results.title: Missing database indexes
results.evidence: 11 hot queries use indexes (SQLite EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN); 40 indexes in the portal DB, 83 in the CRM DB

results.title: Large candidate / job queries
results.evidence: 5,000+ jobs, 10,000+ candidates, 2,000-applicant jobs: responses capped by page size, totals correct (10010 CRM candidates), applicant lists load candidate names in one query (p95 34 ms / 165 ms)

results.title: Pagination
results.evidence: pages don't overlap; oversized page requests (limit=100000) rejected with 422 on 5 list endpoints

results.title: API response time
results.evidence: every response carries X-Response-Time and X-Request-ID; portal GET /jobs (5,000+ jobs): median 9 ms / p95 13 ms; portal GET /jobs search: median 10 ms / p95 14 ms; portal GET /jobs/{id}/applications (2,000 applicants): median 24 ms / p95 34 ms; portal GET /admin/users: median 8 ms / p95 15 ms; CRM GET /candidates (10,000+): median 21 ms / p95 27 ms; CRM GET /candidates search: median 33 ms / p95 48 ms; CRM GET /leads (3,000+): median 18 ms / p95 25 ms; CRM GET /jobs/{id} (2,000 applicants): median 143 ms / p95 165 ms; CRM GET /analytics/overview: median 23 ms / p95 33 ms

results.title: Connection pooling / concurrency
results.evidence: 200 concurrent requests (50 at a time) across both apps: all 200, no 'database is locked'; SQLite in WAL mode with busy timeout; PostgreSQL deployments get a bounded pool (10 + 20 overflow, pre-ping, recycle)

results.title: Error messages
results.evidence: validation errors are readable sentences (e.g. "name: String should have at least 2 characters; email: value is not a "); not-found: "Candidate not found"; unexpected errors return a generic message with a request id instead of a stack trace

results.title: Reports improvements
results.evidence: CSV exports for leads/candidates/placements/invoices/incentives with role rules (HR: invoices 403, own incentives only: 2 rows); revenue now from real invoices: invoiced 306,800, collected 165,200, outstanding 141,600, overdue 141,600; monthly trend and placement funnel {'offered': 1, 'joined': 2, 'dropped': 0, 'left_in_guarantee': 1}

results.title: Backup / recovery
results.evidence: online backup of the live CRM DB while it was serving traffic (25 tables, 15,223 rows, 875,876 bytes gz), integrity verified, restored copy has the same 10,010 candidates; restore refuses to overwrite without --force and keeps the old DB; nightly cron + pre-deploy backup installed by update.sh

results.title: Mobile UX
results.evidence: static review of every page: all 10 tables scroll horizontally on small screens, 43 form grids collapse to one column below 640 px, CRM sidebar becomes a slide-out menu, wide decorative elements are clipped (no sideways scrolling); confirm visually on a phone after deploy

results.title: Website contact form actually delivers enquiries (was a fake 'sent')
results.evidence: message saved (#1) and emailed to bdm@jobsnexgen.com (delivered); HTML in the message is escaped; bad input -> readable 422; 6th message from one IP in an hour -> 429; admin sees it under Enquiries (5 new) and can mark it handled; candidates can't see enquiries (403)

results.title: Newsletter sign-up, weekly job alerts and unsubscribe (was a dead form)
results.evidence: sign-up saved and a confirmation email sent (double opt-in); forged link -> 400, real link confirms; weekly new-jobs email ('10 new jobs on JobsNexGen this week') delivered with job links and an unsubscribe link; pressing 'send now' twice doesn't double-send; unsubscribe works and shows in the admin list

results.title: Freelancer job posts need admin approval
results.evidence: a freelancer's job starts 'awaiting approval' and is hidden from candidates; admins are emailed; the poster can't approve it (403); a rejection reason reaches the poster by email and on their dashboard; editing sends it back for review; after approval it is live and can be closed and reopened without another review; an admin's own job goes live at once (pending now: 0)

results.title: Job form: education, salary per month/year, city and locality; better filters
results.evidence: jobs store minimum education, city + locality and salary per month or per year (bad values -> 422); public search filters by qualification (12th-pass sees 10th jobs, not graduate jobs), by area ('JP Nagar'), and by monthly pay, comparing yearly salaries fairly (7.2L/year = 60k/month); applicants give education, expected salary and current location, and the recruiter sees them

results.title: Premium portal jobs and applicants reach the CRM automatically; free jobs stay out
results.evidence: free portal jobs stay out of the CRM; once an admin marks a job premium (client pays) it appears in the CRM by itself with education, locality, monthly pay and who posted it, and its applicant arrives with education, expected salary, location and resume; portal status changes move the CRM pipeline; a premium job awaiting approval is 'on hold', a deleted one is closed; marking a job filled in the CRM closes it on the portal; making a job free again closes it in the CRM; only owner/BDM can press Sync now

results.title: PRIORITY FLOW: CRM job -> portal -> search -> apply -> CRM -> status both ways, no duplicates
results.evidence: job created in the CRM was live on the portal immediately (premium, client name, education, locality, monthly pay); found by search with 'Bangalore' and with all filters combined, and each filter excludes it when it doesn't match; candidate applied with resume; after two syncs the CRM has exactly 1 job, 1 candidate (with resume, phone, education, location, expected pay) and 1 application; CRM stage changes showed on the candidate's portal dashboard and emailed them; a portal status change reached the CRM; a CRM salary edit updated the portal; the deadline passing closed the job on both sides

results.title: Job filters work alone and together; monthly vs yearly salary handled correctly
results.evidence: 11 filter checks pass on the API (qualification, city with other spellings, area, experience range, several job types, monthly pay) including combinations; pay filters convert yearly salaries to monthly (4.8L/year = 40k/month) and never compare raw yearly numbers; 'highest pay' sorting uses monthly pay; job salary and the candidate's expected salary are separate fields

results.title: API security: no access to others' jobs/candidates by changing IDs; secrets stay server-side
results.evidence: 10 cross-account and unauthenticated attempts were refused (403, 404): another recruiter can't read, edit, delete or move a job's applicants by changing IDs, only admins approve or set premium, the CRM link needs its key; bad input -> 422 on both apps; no secrets in browser code (only the public API and site addresses)

results.title: The portal-CRM link is private
results.evidence: the portal's CRM link refuses requests without the key (403) or with a wrong key (403), and refuses anything arriving through the public website even with the right key (404); only the CRM on the same server can use it
